reason: The hypothesis directly applies the trace boron doping strategy from P21 (which reports B/C doping in MoNbTaW) to the same alloy system NbMoTaW, and combines it with the general idea of interstitial-enhanced ductility from P4 and the inverted BCC+B2 microstructure from P2/P7. The irradiation resistance claim is taken from P22's W-based HEA. The core idea is a straightforward combination of existing results without a new mechanism or transfer to a different material class.
copied_elements: trace B doping to improve ductility of MoNbTaW (P21)
BCC + B2 inverted microstructure for ductility (P2, P7)
